platform: CMap LINCS 2020 Level 3, 10 uM, 24 h, 978 landmark genes

one_example.unit: (cell line, drug group): one drug group measured in one cell line
input: source reference f0: family-balanced mean of the same drug group's measured RNA change over the other source cell families (target family and held-out families excluded)
K support units of the target line: their measured RNA change (treated minus plate control), control mean profile, drug fingerprint (ECFP4), and metadata (plates, wells, control wells)
query drug group: fingerprint and the source reference only; its treated RNA is never an input
one_example.truth: measured RNA change of the query unit = mean over its plate rows of (treated Level 3 profile - mean of DMSO control wells on the same detection plate), 978 genes
one_example.independent_unit: cell family (lines that share an origin are one family); results are family-balanced means. Wells, plates, drug groups, model seeds and support seeds are not independent units.
one_example.metric: per-unit root mean squared error over 978 genes of predicted vs measured RNA change, averaged over query units, then over support seeds / model seeds, then with equal weight over families

held_out.source_train: 121 cell lines in 115 families; 3 family folds (39/38/38, seed 20261117) for every choice of constants, learning rate and number of steps
held_out.source_confirmation: 11 cell lines (meta-validation role inherited unchanged from study R2); 9 families have enough units to form episodes. Used only for fixed confirmation, never for selection.
held_out.target: HUH7, JHH5, JHH7 (hepatocellular carcinoma lines). No expression value of these lines was read in this study before the freeze commit. Splits and support order are the ones fixed in study B (manifests/transigen_adaptation_b1/splits).
held_out.exposure: The HCC lines and these test splits were already scored in studies B and R2 (see EXPOSURE.md). This is a pre-specified follow-up, not a first look.

support_budget.K: number of drug groups with a measured treated profile in the target line; primary 16, auxiliary 8 and 32, nested (8 within 16 within 32)
support_budget.cost_table: manifests/replicate_calibrated_r8/support_cost.tsv (drug groups, treated wells, independent plates, control wells listed separately)

xc_mixed_pools.reason: composition of the pooled lines is not documented in the release metadata

leakage_rules: query treated RNA is never used for inputs, normalisation, shrinkage, weights or confidence (fixture: predictions unchanged when query labels change)
the source reference for a family never contains that family (fixture against brute force)
feature maps, output bases and covariance constants are fitted on source-train families only; inside a fold they are refitted without the fold families
observation covariance uses only replicate / control-sharing metadata of the support wells and constants estimated on source-train replicate plates

store.arrays: not duplicated: expression arrays of studies B and R2 are indexed read-only on the server; nothing with expression values is in Git

not_verifiable_from_release: whether X-tag replicate plates are independent cultures; composition of XC pools; well-level batch effects beyond plate and bead batch
